candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Rebuild this ONE anonymous Liao/Jin northern Chinese city gate map sprite with CORRECT ISOMETRIC GEOMETRY. The supplied image is only a material/style reference: preserve grey clay tile roof, dull brown timber lattice/brackets, ochre-grey rammed-earth piers with grey stone/brick footing and corner guards; realistic ancient Chinese game-kit detail density. It is NOT a geometry reference.
Critical orthographic 2:1 ground projection: yaw 45 degrees, elevation 30 degrees, every ground edge runs exactly TWO screen pixels horizontally for ONE pixel vertically; no perspective, no convergence. Increase the elevation substantially compared to the reference. See much more of the side depth. Footprint width 8 units, depth 4 units. Front wall direction slopes down-right at +0.5, side depth up-right at -0.5. Width-axis screen length exactly TWICE the depth-axis screen length. The TWO masonry piers are each 2 units wide by 4 units deep: each pier is twice as deep as wide. One centered clear passage 4 units wide by 4 units deep, open right through. Along the front width divide 2:4:2. Left exterior ground corner, front corner and right exterior ground corner must clearly form the following proportions: from left exterior corner to front exterior corner +(640,320), from front exterior corner to right exterior corner +(320,-160); rear corner inferred +(320,-160) from left. These are proportion guides not markings.
Use a broad low simple grey tiled gatehouse roof, modest height, heavy timber structure; no Qing palace decoration, no Ming double tower or archway. Two separated rectangular bases, NO continuous ground slab or island; transparent empty passage beneath the upper hall, no doors, floor, steps, banners, text, people, watermark or modern things. Both pier bases on same level, complete feet and eaves. Upper-left light and very short lower-right contact shadow. Generous transparent margins, true RGBA transparency outside and through the opening. ONE complete sprite, not a diagram; no grid, lines, dimension labels or background. Absolute priority is correct 8-by-4 base geometry with piers noticeably deep.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE Liao/Jin northern Chinese city gate, realistic map sprite on TRUE transparent RGBA. Reference small HOUSE is ONLY for same ancient grey-tile/rough-plaster/wood texture density and high-angle game camera; do not create a house. Make a gate comprising two DEEP rammed-earth rectangular piers, clear passage between, ONE grey tiled timber gatehouse on top. Anonymous 11th–13th century northern gate: dark brown timber, restrained brackets, grey-brick base/corner guards, ochre-grey earth, no colored palace paint.
GEOMETRY IS THE PRIMARY SUBJECT: orthographic yaw45 elevation30; exact 2:1 dimetric, screen ground edges ±0.5 slope. Looking downward clearly onto roof and into deep passage, not low-angle facade. The plan is an 8 by 4 rectangle, twice as wide as deep. Piers 2 wide and 4 deep each. Passage 4 wide and 4 deep, centered. This is a compact DEEP gatehouse, not a long thin wall or a paifang. Front facade 2:4:2, passage exactly 50% of facade width. Both piers visibly twice as DEEP as their width.
Place same-ground-level footprint exterior corners (on a 1536px square canvas) at LEFT=(260,850), FRONT=(900,1170), RIGHT=(1220,1010), REAR=(580,690). Therefore front facade ground vector (640,320); side depth vector (320,-160). All masonry courses and straight eaves follow the same ±0.5 projected axes. These are invisible construction coordinates; DO NOT print any lines, numbers or marks. Ground contact bases completely clear and readable. Central passage visible and genuinely transparent all the way through, no closed door, stair, floor slab or ground island. Piers vertical or very slightly battered. Roof must be compact and deep enough for this 8x4 footprint, restrained eaves, no giant thin roof.
Match reference realistic weathered matte texture, muted palette, left-upper light and short lower-right contact shade. Whole object and roof fully within frame, at least8% transparent margins. No scene, sky, human, writing, signage, watermark, dimension labels, grid, checkerboard, modern object, separate buildings. Only ONE gate sprite.
